title: R18 — Accounting-forensic statistical factors: Modified-Jones discretionary accruals (F-A) + Benford FSD (F-B)
universe: KR_top342 (KOSPI200 U KOSDAQ150), monthly membership from monthly_panel.rds (me$K200|KQ150)
benchmark: cap-w KOSPI200 total-return (bench_m$bench_mret) — HARD gate authoritative basis
period_coverage: 2009-06 .. 2025-06 (frozen membership panel; identical to sibling R17 for comparability). NOTE: shorter than 2005+ because monthly_panel.rds starts 200906.

data_sources.fundamentals: .cache/fundamental_merged.parquet (long: Ticker, Period, Period_Date, Factor_Date, Item, Value, Source). PIT via Factor_Date <= sig_date (already encodes annual filing lag).
data_sources.panel: stage_artifacts/WT_D20260711_002/monthly_panel.rds (me + bench_m, pin frozen). returns/bench/size/liq aligned per R17 13b convention.
data_sources.sector: Ticker->Sector static map from .cache/RAWDATA.parquet (27 KR sectors).

pit_convention: expand_hold (frozen, R17): usable decision month = dt2ym(Factor_Date)+1, hold H=12 months forward, keep most-recent active per (Ticker,decision_ym). Factor_Date already includes filing lag (C4). +1 month = mild conservatism, no look-ahead.

F-A.name: Modified-Jones Discretionary Accruals (residual)
F-A.mechanism: Discretionary (managed) accrual component = residual of within-fiscal-year cross-sectional regression of scaled total accruals on 1/A, (dRev-dREC)/A, PPE/A (Jones 1991 + Dechow 1995 receivables adjustment). High discretionary accruals => earnings management => negative forward returns (Sloan 1996, Xie 2001).
F-A.literature: Jones (1991); Dechow-Sloan-Sweeney (1995) modified Jones; Xie (2001); Sloan (1996).
F-A.total_accruals: CF method: TA = NetIncome - OperatingCF (cleaner than BS; Hribar-Collins 2002).
F-A.regression_spec: primary: per-fiscal-year pooled (all firms with valid data that FY, broad estimation), design X = [1/A_lag, (dRev-dREC)/A_lag, PPE/A_lag], y = TA/A_lag, no separate intercept (1/A term is the intercept surrogate). residual eps = discretionary accrual.
F-A.industry_variant: robustness only: add sector fixed-effects when n(sector,FY) >= 15 else fall back to pooled-FY. Primary selection uses pooled-FY.
F-A.score: sign * cross-sectional z(raw) among universe members per decision month
F-A.incrementality_test: cross-sectional monthly corr vs existing DB factor AC13 (original Jones, DB pooled-at-sig-date) computed inline. F-A differs by (i) dREC modified-Jones adjustment, (ii) per-fiscal-year cohort estimation. |corr|>0.9 => redundant with AC13. AC13 prior: standalone LO top25 FAILED (PORT_t 0.227, oos -0.53, Grade F, 2026-06-06).

F-B.name: Benford First-Digit Deviation (FSD_Score)
F-B.mechanism: Financial-statement line items naturally follow Benford's law; deviation of a firm's first-digit distribution from Benford expectation = manipulation fingerprint (Amiram-Bozanic-Rouen 2015). Higher deviation => lower earnings quality => negative forward returns.
F-B.literature: Amiram, Bozanic, Rouen (2015 RAS) FSD_Score; Benford (1938); Nigrini (2012).
F-B.excluded: ALL ratios/margins/growth/deltas/scores (Benford applies only to raw monetary magnitudes spanning multiple orders of magnitude).
F-B.fsd_measure: MAD = mean over d=1..9 of |p_obs(d) - p_exp(d)|, p_exp(d)=log10(1+1/d). Computed per (Ticker, annual Period).
F-B.score: sign * cross-sectional z(raw) among universe members per decision month
F-B.structural_break_flag: source shift QuantiWise(<=2015, ~32 raw items)->DART(2016+, ~24 raw items) changes item set => FSD level shift. Mitigated by monthly cross-sectional z (removes level). 2016+ subperiod reported separately.

measurement.authority: cap-w portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 (canonical_screen_bt, top_n=25, 15bps, liq 2e8). advisory = rank-IC/ICIR.
measurement.dual_basis: diag_ew_universe (EW-uni bench, post2017_t, oos_approx) + diag_cap_tier (MEGA/MID/OTHER) MANDATORY per M2.
robustness: placebo (permute each corp signal across its own months, nsim=200, p=frac sims>=base)
Size-partial (residualize score on Size per month, re-screen)
incrementality corr vs AC13 and F-A vs F-B
measurement.dsr: sweep n_trials=2 => DSR computed as diagnostic (best-of-2 multiple-testing aware).
measurement.verdict_language: negative = 'config-scoped negative + frontier marker' with >=2 next_probe. No premature structural-limit claim (AX-000).

survivor_rule: survivor (cap-w PORT_t>=2.95 AND EW-uni survives AND oos>=0.7) => add_factor recommendation + P-pure substrate extension candidate. else screen-tier/feature per dual-basis.
